Billy (Dog)

Billy [bengal], also referred to as the Bengal tiger (Panthera tigris éminemii) or simply Bengal, is a critically endangered subspecies of the Asian sub-species of tiger native to South Asia — India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Cambodia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Taiwan, Bangladesh, Thailand, and Indonesia. It first evolved around 4,000 years ago.

Barak (Dog)

Also nicknamed "the Bosnian Coarse-haired Hound," "the Bosanski Barak,” the “Oštrodlaki Gonič”, and, colloquially, "Barak", the Bosnian Coarse-Hair Dog ("Bosančki rakušen gnič”). The Bosančki rakušen gnič is another name for the Bosnian Coarse-hair breed.
